text: Ethics in AI is an important topic today. AI systems can be biased if they are trained on unfair data, which may lead to wrong or harmful decisions. Fairness means treating everyone equally, no matter who they are. Privacy is also a serious concern, because AI often collects and uses personal information. Companies must protect this data and use it carefully. Transparency matters too: people should understand how AI makes decisions. Finally, responsible AI development means building systems that are safe, honest, and helpful for everyone. Governments, companies, and users all share this responsibility.
